faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.subheading: What you need to know before getting started. Another question? Request a demo and we'll answer live.

questions.question: Who is the platform for?
questions.answer: For car rental agencies that want to centralize their reservations, contracts, fleet, customers and finances in a single tool — used by both the owner and counter agents.

questions.question: Can I manage several vehicles and reservations?
questions.answer: Yes. Add your fleet and follow all your reservations: each vehicle's availability is checked automatically, and date overlaps are detected to avoid double bookings.

questions.question: Can I generate rental contracts?
questions.answer: Yes. The rental contract is generated from the reservation information: customer, driver, vehicle, dates, rates and deposits.

questions.question: Can I track vehicle expenses and profitability?
questions.answer: Yes. Record expenses per vehicle (maintenance, insurance, financing installments) and review reports for revenue, margins, booked days and occupancy.

questions.question: How does booking via QR code work?
questions.answer: You generate a QR code from your dashboard. Customers scan it, open your public booking page and fill in a request with their details and dates. You review and validate each request.

questions.question: Can I organize my team's tasks?
questions.answer: Yes. Create daily tasks, distribute them and track progress on a shared task list and a Kanban board.

questions.question: How do I find out about pricing?
questions.answer: The monthly, 6-month and annual plans are presented in the Pricing section. For multiple agencies or a large fleet, request a tailored quote through the contact form.

questions.question: How do I request a demo?
questions.answer: Fill in the contact form with your agency name and your needs: the Double V Drive team will get back to you to present the platform.
